verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs list image-to-video in its current video model, with I2V priced as its own tier and keyframe and character-reference controls. However, no documentation explicitly claims that the subject and composition of the source still are preserved during animation. A hands-on community report of morphing and weak temporal coherence lowers confidence, but it is general rather than a specific image-to-video counter-example, so it does not make the claim disputed. Missing for 10: documented guarantees of subject/composition fidelity from the source image, image-to-video specific docs or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of preservation.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved
